# Jenifer Ciuciu-Kiss

> Personal website of Jenifer Tabita Ciuciu-Kiss, an AI and Data Engineer in Zurich working on machine learning, LLM/RAG systems, OCR and document automation, data pipelines, knowledge graphs, semantic web technologies, research software classification, and applied AI research.

Site: https://jeniferciuciukiss.com

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/): Overview, featured work, recruiter paths, blog posts, and contact paths.
- [About](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/about/): Biography, experience, education, skills, CV, and profile summary.
- [Projects](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/projects/): Selected work in AI, data engineering, RAG/document processing, knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, research software, automation, and web development.
- [Research](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/research/): PhD research overview covering research software classification, scientific knowledge graphs, semantic alignment, NLP, and reproducibility.
- [Publications](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/publications/): Research publications with abstracts, PDFs or DOI links where available, BibTeX, and related projects.
- [Blog](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/blog/): Technical writing and project notes.
- [Technical Skills](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/skills/): Skills across AI engineering, data engineering, LLMs, RAG, OCR, semantic web, and research communication.
- [CV](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/about/#cv): CV section on the About page and downloadable PDF CV.
- [Talks and Conferences](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/talks/): Conference, workshop, and public research community activity represented on the site.
- [Contact](https://jeniferciuciukiss.com/contact/): Project request and contact form.

## Content Areas

- Projects cover product, data, automation, research, and website work.
- Publications include journal articles, conference papers, workshop papers, reports, and thesis work.
- Blog posts cover AI, knowledge systems, research software, document processing, and open-source practice.

## Use Guidance

- Cite pages by their canonical URLs when referencing content from this site.
- Prefer project, publication, and blog detail pages for specific claims.
- Do not treat the contact or newsletter forms as content sources.
